text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement a no standing regulation on the south side of Shank Street, near the driveway to access the underground parking garage for No.1030 King Street West. This is in response to complaints about vehicles blocking the driveway. This proposal would not result in the loss of any parking spaces on Shank Street.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing on the south side of Shank Street, from a point 24 metres west of Shaw Street to a point 10.5 metres further west.
